question.text: What was the SEBI circular of January 2023 regarding IRF?

answer.text: Introduction of futures on Corporate Bond Indices
Allowing retail investors to trade IRF without margin
Increasing the lot size for GOI bond futures to 5000
Permitting physical settlement for 10-year GOI bond futures

explanation.text: The Logic: In January 2023, SEBI issued a circular enabling the introduction of futures contracts on Corporate Bond Indices. This was a significant expansion of the IRF product universe beyond government securities. The Trap: No margin-free trading was introduced. Lot sizes were not changed. Physical settlement was not reintroduced. The 2023 development specifically pertained to corporate bond index futures. Cross-Exam Context: This development signals the maturation of India's interest rate derivatives market. Corporate bond index futures allow hedging of corporate bond portfolios, a facility previously available only through OTC credit default swaps.
